manuscript_claim: Raw SRA/FASTQ, whole pangenome assemblies and all epigenome tracks were deferred; v0.1 uses processed matrices first.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Processed-matrix first strategy; raw/high-volume modalities reserved for later validation or sequence-tokenizer work.
verification_evidence: Download rationale and two batch check reports exist.

manuscript_claim: ZEAMAP phenotype, population and genotype identifiers were harmonized to accession level.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Accession-level harmonization; expression columns recorded but not forced into accession-level v0.1.
verification_evidence: Stage 1 report documents population/phenotype/VCF sample alignment.

manuscript_claim: v0.1 contains 461 paired accessions, 199,856 SNPs and 318 numeric traits.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Common high-call biallelic SNPs; accession has genotype, population and at least one phenotype/metabolome measurement.
verification_evidence: Build report and processed matrix paths document sample and feature counts.

manuscript_claim: Initial genotype/population prediction benchmark found stable signal and motivated trait filtering.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Train/validation/test split 322/69/70; genotype PCA and ridge baselines.
verification_evidence: Baseline report records first-pass median Pearson/R2 and model ranking.

manuscript_claim: Trait screening reduced noisy outcomes before multi-seed benchmarking.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Selected traits are retained based on evaluability and baseline evidence.
verification_evidence: Selected-traits report documents selected trait count and family composition.

manuscript_claim: Repeated-seed evaluation identified 66 robust traits.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Five random seeds; robust traits retained for final benchmark.
verification_evidence: Robustness report records 66 robust traits and family counts.

manuscript_claim: Ridge/ElasticNet were more stable than small MLP under current sample size.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Lightweight ridge, ElasticNet and small MLP comparison on robust traits.
verification_evidence: Lightweight model report supports restrained model choice.

manuscript_claim: Methylation remained auxiliary and was not used as the v0.1 main-model input.
key_parameters_or_decisions: 236 methylation-covered accessions; global summary, gene/promoter/cis-window PCA and sparse gene-window checks.
verification_evidence: Three methylation reports document limited or unstable gain.

manuscript_claim: Final benchmark used genotype_population_ridge; oil traits were strongest.
key_parameters_or_decisions: 66 robust traits; final model genotype_population_ridge; oil median Pearson/R2 0.596/0.321.
verification_evidence: Final benchmark report documents model and trait-family performance.

manuscript_claim: Ridge attribution provided support used only as orthogonal prioritization, not causal evidence.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Attribution screen after final benchmark; interpreted as prioritization support only.
verification_evidence: Attribution report preserves non-GWAS claim boundary.

manuscript_claim: Covariate-only GWAS was inflated and retained only as a diagnostic baseline.
key_parameters_or_decisions: PC1-PC3 + K1-K3 residualization; lambda GC 2.41-3.97.
verification_evidence: GWAS baseline report documents inflation and diagnostic-only status.

manuscript_claim: GEMMA LMM used genotype-derived kinship and population covariates.
key_parameters_or_decisions: 10 high-priority oil traits; genotype-derived kinship; PC1-PC3/K1-K3 covariates.
verification_evidence: GEMMA run script and Stage 5.3 report document LMM setup.

manuscript_claim: GEMMA LMM controlled lambda GC to 0.984-1.018 across 10 oil traits.
key_parameters_or_decisions: p_lrt as main p-value; Bonferroni/FDR/suggestive summaries; QQ/Manhattan figures generated.
verification_evidence: Summary TSV and report document sample/SNP counts, lambda and lead hits.

manuscript_claim: GEMMA lead loci were annotated to B73 RefGen_v4 candidate genes and filtered to manuscript-facing loci.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Nominal-only loci excluded from manuscript set; 184 candidate loci and 147 genes retained.
verification_evidence: Candidate loci report and TSVs document filtering and annotation.

manuscript_claim: Top loci were ranked into tiered manuscript candidates and 8 regional targets.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Priority score integrates statistical support, trait recurrence, attribution overlap and annotation evidence.
verification_evidence: Top-locus report documents tier1/tier2 and regional figure targets.

manuscript_claim: Manuscript tables summarize regional evidence, tier-1 loci, candidates and literature/source records.
key_parameters_or_decisions: 8 top regional loci; 18 tier1 main loci; 184 supplementary manuscript loci.
verification_evidence: Stage 5.6 report and manuscript tables are committed.

manuscript_claim: Figure 1, Figure 2 and Figure 3 are generated in PDF/SVG/PNG formats.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Nature-style double-column PDF/SVG/PNG; manual final inspection remains required.
verification_evidence: Stage 5.12 figure audit exists; Stage 5.14 manual checklist still has placeholders.

manuscript_claim: Eight top regional association/LD/gene-track figures support candidate intervals.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Regional panels show association strength, LD to lead SNP and B73 RefGen_v4 gene tracks.
verification_evidence: Regional figure directory contains PDF/SVG/PNG for R01-R08.
reviewer_risk_addressed: R04 domain interpretation and R06 figure readiness

manuscript_claim: Top regional loci received external annotation hardening and claim-boundary risk labels.
key_parameters_or_decisions: External annotation class and remaining risk assigned; no causal validation implied.
verification_evidence: Stage 5.11 report and external annotation table are committed.

manuscript_claim: Target-journal manuscript assembly combines title page placeholders, abstract, results, methods, legends and availability statements.
key_parameters_or_decisions: The Plant Genome first-line format with G3 as alternative; author-side fields intentionally unresolved.
verification_evidence: Stage 5.12 report and final assembly draft are committed.
reviewer_risk_addressed: R01 manuscript depth and R05 reproducibility

manuscript_claim: Final submission gates remain closed until author metadata, manual figure checks and release are complete.
key_parameters_or_decisions: Preflight requires no blocking placeholders; Stage 5.17 single form is now the preferred source of truth.
verification_evidence: Stage 5.15/5.16/5.17 reports document current metadata blockers.
